name: paleoarchean-era-begins
description: Stable continental fragments grow, and microbial mats build the first layered stromatolite reefs in shallow seas.

name: mesoarchean-era-begins
description: Photosynthesising microbes spread through the oceans while the first large, enduring landmasses take shape.

name: rhyacian-period-begins
description: Oxygen is now in the air for good, and ice sheets reach the tropics in one of the planet's earliest great glaciations.

name: mesoproterozoic-era-begins
description: A long, calm stretch of stable climate and ocean chemistry opens, with cells growing more complex beneath the waves.

name: neoproterozoic-era-begins
description: The supercontinent Rodinia sits largely intact and begins to split apart, setting up the world's coldest spells.

name: cambrian-period-opens
description: Animals with shells, eyes and legs suddenly fill warm shallow seas in a burst of new body plans.

name: late-devonian-epoch-begins
description: Tree-sized forests spread across the continents while armoured fishes rule seas that are about to suffer repeated crises.

name: pennsylvanian-epoch-begins
description: Coal swamps blanket low-lying lands, and the first reptiles lay shelled eggs that can hatch away from water.

name: late-triassic-epoch-begins
description: Monsoon rains fall on the great supercontinent, and early dinosaurs share it with crocodile-like rivals.

name: late-jurassic-epoch-begins
description: The Atlantic widens, warm seas deepen, and plated and long-necked giants graze lush floodplains.

name: late-cretaceous-epoch-begins
description: Sea levels peak and the climate is a greenhouse, as the great horned and tyrant dinosaurs rise to rule.
